lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Cohort 01, you were selected because this mission requires people who can adapt for decades, not simply survive a launch. Asteria is not a rescue. It is a beginning.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Nobody deletes the record.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Speak plainly. Tell the crew what you see before you tell them what it means.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Because humanity should never have only one home. Earth is not dying. We are choosing to build a second civilization on Asteria-4.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: We will disagree. When we do, speak plainly, listen closely, and make your reasons visible to one another.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: You do not have to know who you will become before you board.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: If you forgot to say goodbye to someone, you have about forty seconds to decide whether that matters.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: This is your ship too. What would make a room feel like yours?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Then give your character something to do with their hands. We can see a tightened strap or a folded note. We cannot see a thought.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Who crosses first? Who hangs back? Who notices? You can disagree and still cross the same line.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Start with what each person wants right now. Then show us what they do to get it.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Cohort 01 biometric integration complete.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Maintenance authority is active. How may I assist?

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: The navigation estimates are available. State your question.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: CSV-01 Pioneer. Destination: Asteria-4. Mission: establish a deliberate second civilization. Earth remains habitable.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Flight navigates. Science investigates. Engineering maintains the ship. Colony helps a community take shape. Each department depends on the others.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: insufficient image duration for classification.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: The unit is operating within maintenance authority.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Every ship is a collection of problems that have agreed not to happen at the same time.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: That unit is either malfunctioning or developing artistic opinions. Both are unacceptable.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Four correct clocks can still make one impossible system.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Shut it down, trap it, redirect it, or cut its power. Protect the ship and the people first.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Machines lie less often than people. That does not mean they never lie.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Notice what changes. Check before you act. A good question can prevent a very expensive repair.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: If the instrument is wrong, tell me how. If physics is wrong, I need a longer lunch.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: The mass and lensing readings cannot be reconciled under normal physics.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Keep the observation separate from the explanation. Tell us what you measured, then tell us what you think it means.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Test that model. The magnitude and pattern do not fit ordinary relativistic effects.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Your body is part of the mission equipment. Unlike the equipment, you are allowed to disagree with me.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Your cells do not know they are supposed to agree with the ship clock.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Before anyone volunteers to be repaired, come see me.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: The difference is an observation. It is not yet an explanation.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Make time to rest. Speak up when something feels wrong. Looking after a community begins with noticing one another.

lines.speaker: m77
lines.text: OBSTRUCTION DETECTED. REPAIRING OBSTRUCTION.

lines.speaker: m77
lines.text: PLEASE DO NOT INTERFERE WITH YOUR PREVIOUS REPAIR.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Welcome aboard Pioneer.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Route correction accepted.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Who entered that correction?

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: No correction was entered.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Estimated time to Asteria: thirty-seven days.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Both.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Correct according to what frame of reference?

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Yes.
